installer: add a static file MD5SUM into the self-extracting archive Generate a deterministic MD5SUM and add into the self-extracting archive when packing and repacking. BUG=b:36083439 TEST=manually 1. cd toolkit 2. make toolkit -C .. 3. mv install_factory_toolkit.run a.run 4. ./a.run --noexec --target a 5. make toolkit -C .. 6. mv install_factory_toolkit.run b.run 7. ./b.run --noexec --target b 8. ./b.run -- --repack b --pack-into c.run 9. ./c.run --noexec --target c 10. touch c/usr/local/factory/dummy 11. ./b.run -- --repack c --pack-into d.run 12. ./d.run --noexec --target d 13. check MD5SUM in each directory, expecting A = B = C != D Change-Id: I2921d848afe8feb7eb3ab61c1533df33dc9ee74f Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/452398 Commit-Ready: Youcheng Syu <youcheng@chromium.org> Tested-by: Youcheng Syu <youcheng@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mao Huang <littlecvr@chromium.org>

dump_vpd_log: Functionalize and minor style fixes. Put main logic into function 'main', including temp file creation and argument processing. Also revised coding style in redirection: '> FILE' to '>FILE'. No function changes except definition of shflags and arg processing (and 'set -e') is now executed before temp files creation. This is needed because in the future we will change location of files according to the flags. gyroscope: display sensor values in goofy UI. Gyro test requires operator to rotate the device along 3 axises, the test passes when all axises are greater then given threshold. Without any information on UI, operator is hard to know which axis haven't pass the threshold yet. To improve this, print sensor values we collected with color indicates pass/fail on UI for better usability. BUG=None TEST=Run gyroscope test.
